WITH customer_engagement AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.scoredate - c.tenureyrs * INTERVAL '1 year') AS cohort_quarter,
           CASE WHEN (b.chaninvdatablock ->> 'onlineuse' = 'High'
                       OR b.chaninvdatablock ->> 'mobileuse' = 'High')
                      AND b.chaninvdatablock ->> 'autopay' = 'Yes'
                THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_digital_native,
           0.4 * h.produsescore + 0.3 * h.chanusescore
           + 0.2 * b.bankrelscore + 0.1 * (h.custservint / 10.0) AS ces
    FROM core_record c
    JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON b.bankexpref = c.coreregistry
    JOIN credit_accounts_and_history h ON h.histcompref = c.coreregistry
)

       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
       AVG(ces) AS engagement_score,
       100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ces > 0.7) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage,
       100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_digital_native AND ces > 0.7)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_digital_native), 0) AS digital_native_high_engagement_percentage
FROM customer_engagement
GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native
